messages:
anita: Quick sync — digging into image provenance extraction for the compliance audit next week. Main items: KMS-signed SBOMs, attestation metadata (builder, git sha, base layers), RBAC for signer keys, and where audit logs need to land. Who can join a short deep-dive?
marc: I can. Thoughts: use cosign for signatures + Rekor for transparency. KMS key in our cloud envelope; restrict signer role to build CI and a small ops group.
sam_devops: ping @marc — we already have a keystore role binding for the deploy signer; will that suffice for image signing or do we need a new key per pipeline?
kate_prodsec: Recommend new per-pipeline envelopes (or at least per-repo) so we can revoke without blowing up unrelated repos. Also need RBAC on Rekor write access and a readonly token for consumers.
marc: Agreed. New key per-repo is safer. Example cosign command for sig+attest:
```
COSIGN_PASSWORD=\"\" cosign sign-blob --key kms://projects/…/locations/…/keyRings/…/cryptoKeys/… image.tar
cosign attest --type grafeas \"image:sha256:...\" --attestor <attestor>
```
anita: For audit logs we need identity of signer (user or CI service account), key id, Rekor entry id, and bundle -> retention 1 year (audit). Where do we ship these events?
security-bot: Snyk scan: new glibc issue detected in base-202306 layers — CVE-2023-XXXXX. Low->high: needs triage. (automated)
jordan_sre: For log sink, send to centralized audit cluster (logger-audit-prod). We also mirror into security-gcs for long-term retention. Need a schema for events — field list: event_type, subject, key_id, signer_identity, rekor_index, sbom_url, repo, commit, timestamp.
sam_devops: I'll open infra ticket to provision per-repo KMS key templates + IAM docs. Also propose a small lambda that, on build success, writes a canonical event to logger-audit-prod and stores SBOM + attest in our artifact bucket.
kate_prodsec: On CVE triage: we should gate new base-image builds to fail on critical CVEs, and create an expedited rebuild workflow. We also need a canary rollout for new base images.
marc: For runtime security: we should embed image attestation verification into the admission controller. If attest present and cosign-verifies with Rekor proof -> allow. Else -> quarantine.
anita: Sounds good. Action items:
- sam_devops: infra ticket for per-repo KMS keys + IAM template (ETA EOD).
- marc: sketch attestor + admission controller flow (ETA tomorrow).
- kate_prodsec: CVE gating rules + canary playbook (ETA Monday).
- jordan_sre: event schema + logger-audit-prod sink details (ETA EOD).
Also we need a short runbook for key compromise: revoke key, mark affected images, trigger rebuilds, notify customers. Who owns that?
kate_prodsec: I can draft the runbook with seceng.
anita: Cool. Let's meet 40 mins after this thread to go over the design. If anyone can't make it, drop notes here. :thumbsup:
marc: joining. :+1:
sam_devops: creating ticket now — will paste link when done.
sam_devops: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-8921 created. KMS key template and audit sink tasks. PTAL.
anita: got it, thx. If possible include a sample Rekor payload and recommended Rekor retention in the ticket.
jordan_sre: will add event schema to ticket. Also: recommend Rekor archival to GCS monthly just in case.
anita: ok wrapping — see you in 40. Thanks all.
